Consider awaiting the fetch or resolving the AOP name-map from tax at open time, or refetch specialty AOPs once and cache in Professionals.jsx.

critical_code_review_comments: professionals_get / _list / _create rely on _prof_public to strip _id — good, but ProfessionalBody.model_dump() emits None for all optional fields so a bare POST {surname:'X'} would insert visibility=null, sphere_id=null etc. Consider exclude_none on model_dump or filter None values before insert. Not blocking.
PATCH uses model_dump() then filters None — but a legit clear (e.g. set accepting_patients from true->null) is impossible because None fields are dropped. Consider explicit unset semantics if needed.

ProfileView aopMap not pre-populated in the initial Professionals.jsx tax bundle (task designs AOPs as specialty-scoped so bundling all is heavy — but at least resolve on modal open before painting chips).
